title: Menlo Ventures首度参与IPO配置 押注Anthropic长期基本面
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: I am curious if you can go back to your early investment in Anthropic and what you saw obviously at the time a company Effectively without a product a company with a lot of promise right and we were heard from the CFO earlier today about
segments.zh: 我很好奇，您能否回顾一下早期对Anthropic的配置，当时您显然看到了一家实际上没有产品但潜力巨大的公司，今天早些时候我们听到了CFO关于

segments.en: The phenomenal growth this company has had in less than six years. Sure. What did you see back then?
segments.zh: 这家公司不到六年取得的惊人增长。当然。当时您看到了什么？

segments.en: I'm in special team Daria is one of the most smartest kind of capable thoughtful people you'll meet a great kind of Cultural mindset around trust and safety that was kind of a foundational tenant of the company as you know at the time
segments.zh: 我在特别团队，Daria是你能遇到的最聪明、最有能力、最深思熟虑的人之一，围绕信任和安全有一种伟大的文化心态，正如你所知，这是公司当时的基础原则

segments.en: That you mentioned it was pre-revenue pre-product and yet they were benchmarking the models against open AI Which was kind of leading the frontier at the time and they were at or better than them on almost every dimension
segments.zh: 你提到它当时没有收入、没有产品，但他们将模型与当时处于前沿的OpenAI进行基准比较，几乎在每个维度上都达到或超过他们

segments.en: And they'd raised like one one hundredth the capital So you kind of look at capital efficiency great team trust and safety And you know as soon as they launched the model into the wild the revenue just started to soar
segments.zh: 而他们筹集的资金只有约百分之一，所以你看资本效率、伟大团队、信任和安全，而且一旦他们将模型推向市场，收入就开始飙升

segments.en: But it's a big day because for Menlo, it's the first time You're investing in an IPO. Yeah, I know you as an early stage guy
segments.zh: 但今天是个大日子，因为对Menlo Ventures来说，这是你们第一次参与IPO。是的，我知道你是早期阶段的市场参与者

segments.en: How much of the allocation did you get? We got about 50% of our allocation But what did you ask for? Well just a good a good number nothing nothing outrageous
segments.zh: 你们获得了多少分配？我们获得了约50%的分配。但你们要求了多少？嗯，只是一个不错的数字，没什么离谱的

segments.en: It's not really our business to invest in IPOs. You're right. We're early and growth stage investor But like we just felt this was such an exceptional opportunity
segments.zh: 参与IPO并不是我们的主要业务。你说得对，我们是早期和成长阶段的市场参与者，但我们觉得这是一个非常特殊的机会

segments.en: We really believe in the long-term Fundamentals the S1 speaks for itself the size of this market where we are early innings of growth So we we wanted to expand the position not looking to
segments.zh: 我们真的相信长期基本面，S1文件本身就能说明问题，这个市场的规模，我们正处于增长的早期阶段，所以我们想扩大仓位，不打算

segments.en: To sell and thinking more about the future than than where it is right now
segments.zh: 卖出，更多考虑未来而不是现在的位置
